_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every Nerve version number, date and download link on the site.
Edit this file only — never edit version numbers inside the HTML by hand.
`npm run build` (which Vercel runs automatically on every deploy) rewrites every
element marked data-rel="..." and data-rel-link="..." in the HTML from the values below.
A link is rendered as a real, clickable button ONLY when its status is "available"
AND its url is a non-empty https:// URL. Otherwise it renders as a non-clickable,
disabled control carrying the pendingLabel. This is deliberate: the acceptance
checklist requires that no placeholder link is ever clickable.
